clues.text: This city sits on the south west coast of Turkey. High peaks stand just back from the shore.
clues.narrowing: rules out everything outside the southwest coast of Turkey

source.quote: Recognized as the "capital of tourism" in Turkey and a pivotal part of the Turkish Riviera, Antalya sits on Anatolia's southwest coast, flanked by the Taurus Mountains.

clues.text: High peaks trap wet air near the shore. That brings hard rain in winter, and summers turn very hot here.
clues.narrowing: rules out coast cities without trapped moisture, wet winters, and very hot summers

source.quote: With moisture being trapped, the local climate thus has high winter rainfall, while the interior bay setting results in very hot summers for a coastal city.

clues.text: A king built this city two hundred years before Christ. His name was Attalus, and Rome took the place soon after.
clues.narrowing: rules out all but the ancient port founded by King Attalus the Second

source.quote: The city was formerly known as Attaleia, founded around 200 BC by King Attalus II of Pergamon. Attaleia was soon conquered by the Romans.

clues.text: This place is the fourth most seen city in the whole wide world for trips. Only three famed world cities draw more guests from far lands each year.
clues.narrowing: rules out all but the fourth most visited city in the world

source.quote: Antalya is currently the fourth-most visited city in the world, trailing behind only Istanbul, London, and Dubai, attracting more than 16.5 million foreign visitors in 2023.

clues.text: This is Turkey's biggest sea resort, set on the Turkish Riviera. Guests fly in from all round the world to enjoy its sun and sea.
clues.narrowing: confirms it as Turkey's biggest sea resort on its famed Riviera coast

source.quote: The city is Turkey's biggest international sea resort on the Turkish Riviera.
